mapper.select:
WITH boarding_position AS ( SELECT rd.line_id, rd.id AS direction_id, boarding.stop_id, MIN(boarding.stop_sequence) AS stop_sequence FROM route_direction rd INNER JOIN directed_stop boarding ON boarding.direction_id = rd.id AND boarding.line_id = rd.line_id WHERE rd.line_id = #{lineId} AND rd.id = #{directionId} AND rd.active = TRUE AND boarding.stop_id = #{boardingStopId} GROUP BY rd.line_id, rd.id, boarding.stop_id ) SELECT boarding.line_id AS "lineId", boarding.direction_id AS "directionId", boarding.stop_id AS "boardingStopId", boarding.stop_sequence AS "boardingSequence",
alighting.stop_id AS "alightingStopId", alighting.stop_sequence AS "alightingSequence"
CAST(NULL AS UUID) AS "alightingStopId", CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "alightingSequence"
FROM boarding_position boarding
INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.stop_id, candidate.stop_sequence FROM directed_stop candidate WHERE candidate.direction_id = boarding.direction_id AND candidate.line_id = boarding.line_id AND candidate.stop_id = #{alightingStopId} AND candidate.stop_sequence > boarding.stop_sequence ORDER BY candidate.stop_sequence LIMIT 1 ) alighting ON TRUE
